summary: Frontend regression testing for App Store compliance changes. Onboarding location screen verified: CTA is 'Continuer' and the 'Passer' button is correctly ABSENT on that screen only (present on all others). Location text 'Night Finder utilise ta position pour afficher les clubs, événements et utilisateurs proches de toi' is in code at onboarding.tsx:268. Login smoke passed with apple.reviewer credentials (discover-screen loads, 4 tabs navigable, no red screen). Clubs list loads on Home (Concrete, Le Syndicat, Trending tonight sections visible — the sections literally named 'Clubs proches'/'Tous les clubs' are on /clubs list page, not home; home 'discover-screen' uses 'Trending tonight' and 'People near you' — no regression, data loads fine). Settings 'Détection en club' row rendered correctly with new FR subtitle in code (fr.ts:162-163); reviewer account uses English so label displays as 'Club detection' with 'While the app is open, we'll prompt you to confirm your night when you arrive at a club' — same fix, correctly translated. Toggle on web does NOT crash; switch stays off (Alert 'Disponible sur mobile uniquement' path triggered — RN Alert on web is silent but functional). Paywall renders with black bg, 4 benefits (Voir qui est là ce soir / Swipes illimités / Filtres avancés / Boost de profil), 4,99€ mensuel / 79,99€ annuel, 'Essayer Premium' CTA, 'Restaurer mes achats', and both links Conditions → /legal?doc=cgu and Confidentialité → /legal?doc=privacy work. My-songs screen loads correctly; the '10 secondes d'écoute, rapproche ton téléphone…' helper text is CONDITIONAL (shown only during scanning at my-songs.tsx:236) — default idle text is 'Auto quand tu es détecté en boîte · ou tape pour scanner maintenant'. Code review confirms all requested App Store cleanup is in place. No React Native red-screen errors, no deprecated packages introduced by these changes.
